# Vendored PDF.js

- Version: `4.10.38`
- Files: `pdf.min.mjs`, `pdf.worker.min.mjs`
- Source: <https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/4.10.38/> (Mozilla PDF.js distribution)
- License: Apache-2.0. The bundled files retain their upstream license headers.

The prototype loads these local ESM files so an offline localhost run still renders the local PDF. The browser PDF embed is only an explicit error fallback.
